text: Founder Elizabeth Zalman and investor Jerry Neumann examine venture-backed startups from opposite sides of the table. Their debate follows the relationship through raising money, negotiating terms, working with a board, pursuing growth, and arranging an exit. By exploring conflicting incentives and the distance between promises and behavior, they show how trust can unravel and offer a candid account of the partnerships on which ambitious companies depend.
author: Elizabeth Joy Zalman and Jerry Neumann
